Alternatives order: Jan first. Ollama is a runtime with a CLI and API and needs a separate interface (Open WebUI, which is not OSI open source) for a chat window; Jan is one desktop chat app that runs open models offline with no account and also takes OpenAI or Anthropic keys, and exposes an OpenAI-compatible local server. LibreChat is the pick for teams.
Jan: desktop app, offline use, no account, API keys for OpenAI/Anthropic, local OpenAI-compatible server on port 1337
LibreChat: multi-user sign-in (email, OAuth2, LDAP), ChatGPT-style web interface
Ollama: runs models locally with a CLI chat (ollama run) and a REST API
Cherry Studio README links a mobile app, Open WebUI and LibreChat can run as PWAs; wording softened to 'no project matches the official mobile apps'
ChatGPT memory, built-in tools and app features are not part of the API
Jan Web is mentioned in the docs as a separate browser offering; the installed app is desktop only
